title: Incorrect authorization in the sendForm RPC handler and Session JWT reconnect handling in ONLYOFFICE Docs (Document…
description: ONLYOFFICE Docs (Document Server) version 9.4.0-129 contains an authorization flaw in the sendForm RPC handler and Session JWT reconnect handling. An authenticated user with view-only permissions can export a reconstructed copy of a document, including content not displayed to the viewer, such as custom XML and document properties, even when download and form-filling are disabled. This occurs because the Session JWT does not bind the callback URL, allowing an attacker to substitute a malicious URL and receive the document via RPC.
